name: Yuki Hotaru ~Nidome no Hatsukoi~
original_name: 雪ほたる～二度目の初恋～
source:
Yosuke does not have a girlfriend in his twenties because of mistakes of the past. One day he learns about death of the girl he loved at school. Upon returning to hometown a strange phenomenon happens - he becomes able to move to past and correct his mistakes one by one.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
洋介已经二十多岁，却因为过去犯下的错误而一直没有女朋友。一天，他得知学生时代爱慕的少女已经去世。返回故乡后，一种奇异现象发生在他身上：他获得了回到过去、逐一纠正错误的能力。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
